properties.description: The executable form of ver:every-prose-field-is-searched-or-named-as-not-prose. Its NOT_PROSE table lists each string property search deliberately skips, with one of seven reasons (when, which, hash, where, category, provenance, payload). A new string property fails the test until it is flagged fulltext or listed.
properties.name: crates/reflow2-core/tests/every_prose_field_is_searched.rs — every string property is searched or named as not prose
